rag.text:
Test: TC-4333 — new Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Editing Status and Assignee in Task Details Dialog
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-471 Box Module - Resources - New Resource Grid
Labels: be-enterprise, can_be_automated

Description:
Ze względu na ograniczoną liczbę użytkowników na cloudzie, user TC4333-user1 nie ma uprawnień do Jiry, więc nie można mu przypisać taska. Na potrzeby przejścia przez TC należy dodać usera do grupy Jira Setting → User management → Groups → search jira-users-(instanceName) → Show details → Add group members. Usuń usera z grupy po wykonanym teście

Steps:
1. Navigate to Resources Module of the boxName.

Expand ‘Backlog’ sidebar.
   Data: boxName: TC-4333 Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Editing Status and Assignee in Task Details Dialog
   Expected: Resources module is successfully loaded and displayed.
The beginning of Timeline is set to 01/Mar/2022.
Individuals view - All is selected in the left top corner.
Effort mode is set to Original estimate and Units to Hours.
Scale is set to Month/Weekly.
All rows are expanded.

Following tasks are visible:

* Task 1 in Unassigned row
* Task 2 assigned to TC4333-user1

One unassigned task ‘Task 1’ is visible in the 'Backlog' sidebar.
2. Collapse the 'Backlog' sidebar.
Click on taskbar of the taskName.
   Data: taskName: Task 1
   Expected: The sidebar is collapsed.

Task Details Dialog is displayed.
Task details dialog is divided into sections:

* Basic info
* Resources
* Scheduling
* Agile
* Time estimates
* Technical info
* Workload contouring
* Warnings
* Multi-team planning (Time estimates)
* Multi-team planning (Story points)
3. In Technical info section hover over ‘In scope of’ value
   Data: Jira Server
value: PROG-3202

Jira Cloud
value: PROG-2907
   Expected: Tooltip appears: "Main > TC-4333 Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Editing Status and Assignee in Task Details Dialog"
4. Go to Basic info section.
   Expected: Basic info is display
Following informations are visible:

Progress in %
Status
Priority
5. Click on Status.
   Expected: Dropdown menu appears with the options:

* To Do
* In Progress
* Done
6. Change the Status to newStatus.
   Data: newStatus: In Progress
   Expected: Status is changed. Task colour changed from grey to blue.
7. Go to Resources section and click on Unassigned in Assignee row.
   Expected: Dropdown menu dialog appears. The search field with placeholder "Search by name (at least 2 characters)" is on the top of the dialog. Under its is the list of users.
8. Fill in userName in the search field, select it from the list, and click outside the Task details dialog.
   Data: FOR Atlassian Cloud read description first.

userName: TC4333-user1
   Expected: The task details dialog is closed.

Task 'Task 1' is assigned to user 'TC4333-user1' and is displayed in user row on Resource Grid.
9. Expand the 'Backlog' sidebar.
   Expected: The ‘Backlog' sidebar is expanded.￼
The splash screen with information is displayed:￼
"No tasks matching your filters
You have filters enabled that result in hidden tasks."￼
’Clear active filters' button is visible under the information
10. Collapse the 'Backlog sidebar.
Click on taskbar of the taskName and change the Status to newStatus.
   Data: taskName: Task 1
newStatus: Done
   Expected: The sidebar is collapsed.

Status is changed. Task colour changed from blue to green.
11. Click on userName in Assignee row.
   Data: userName: TC4333-user1
   Expected: Dropdown menu dialog appears. The search field with placeholder "Search by name (at least 2 characters)" is on the top of the dialog. Under its is the list of users.
12. Select newUserName in the search field and click outside the Task details dialog.
   Data: newUserName: Unassigned
   Expected: The task details dialog is closed.

Task 'Task 1' is unassigned and is displayed in Unassigned row on Resource Grid.
13. Click on taskbar of the taskName.
   Data: taskName: Task 2
   Expected: Task Details Dialog is displayed.
Task details dialog is divided into sections:

* Basic info
* Resources
* Scheduling
* Agile
* Time estimates
* Technical info
* Workload contouring
* Warnings
* Multi-team planning (Time estimates)
* Multi-team planning (Story points)
14. Click on userName in Assignee row.
   Data: userName: TC4333-user1
   Expected: Dropdown menu dialog appears. The search field with placeholder "Search by name (at least 2 characters)" is on the top of the dialog. Under its is the list of users.
15. Fill in userName in the search field, select it from the list, and click outside the Task details dialog.
   Data: userName: TC4333-user2
   Expected: The task details dialog is closed.

FOR Atlassian Server:
Task 'Task 2' is assigned to user 'TC4333-user2' and is displayed in user row on Resource Grid.

FOR Atlassian Cloud:
Warning dialog appears with the message:
"Error\!
It looks like user TC4333-user2 might not have Assignable user permission granted in Jira. If that's not the case, please contact our Support."
